title: [codex] Sharp 7q stage-rank budget for all even dimensions and coupled widths
body:
For **every even n>=4 and every coupled width q**, any three commuting compatible full-stage projectors in a shortest n+1-query tuple on nq independent fields, satisfying their actual chronological-prefix conditions, have **total stage rank at least7q**. Individual ranks may differ and internal port matrices need not commute. An explicit unimodular ordinary frame attains(2q,3q,2q) with literal endpoint `S diag(ABC,AB,B,C,1,...,1)` at every n,q. The field has characteristic different from two.

In particular, two minimum-rank2q full stages force every other full stage to have rank at least3q. A coupled q2 rank13 Gram configuration cannot become a complete independent-stage caller by increasing the even field count while retaining the shortest-query contract.

The uniform proof has three cases:

- An even interior site has zero-paired image/row closure of dimensions2q and2q, so its stage already needs rank4q.
- Each odd interior site contains a forced rank2q projector. Two such forced projectors have commutator rank2q; making the actual stages commute needs at leastq extra dimensions between them.
- With only one odd interior site and both endpoints, a far-endpoint leakage bound gives `rank(Q)>=4q-2e`, where e is the odd stage's extra rank. This imposes the same total extra-rank debtq.

These cases exhaust every triple at every even n. The attainment retains every original independent input, including the extra central-only outputs. A genuine compatible q2 rank13 shortest tuple is included as a failed-prefix scope control, not a priced supplier.

Credit: Ali Romman's #6398 already gives the scalar all-even obstruction, image/row closure method and forced odd projector. The complete coupled normal form and the all-length fixed alternating-interior/curvature and generic low-rank correction tools are also retained predecessor results, following Cinna Davis's query/controller lineage. Original source bytes/notices remain exact. The new contribution is the uniform arbitrary-three mixed-rank threshold from quantitative odd-pair and endpoint-leakage arguments, plus the explicit all-n attaining family. Targeted repository review found no matching coupled mixed-rank statement; no world priority is claimed.

- Complete multivariate stage endpoints retain all independent inputs. Uniform prefix/commutator/far-closure formulas, exact attaining words and necessary failure controls are rebuilt.
- The written proof supplies unbounded n,q and field scope. Finite controls corroborate conventions. Reviews and both implementations are author-side AI-assisted evidence.
